cases.notes: pytest 8 removes the hook API this plugin uses (see TvoroG/pytest-lazy-fixture#65; Debian bug 1066727; Backblaze b2-sdk-python #484). Its own tests pass on pytest 7 and fail on pytest 8 during plugin/collection load.

teamtomo/imodmodel#11 documents that pytest>=8 breaks pytest-lazy-fixture in its test env, causing failures. pyproject pins nothing for the plugin, so the pinned install reproduces the environment the issue describes. Small pure-python+numpy/pandas repo.

At c0719987 (0.8.0, 2023) the project is Pydantic-v1-only (pydantic>=1.9,<2; SupImDos/pydantic-argparse#56 shows v2 support arrived much later via a shim). Upgrading pydantic to 2.x breaks the v1-only test suite; pytest-mock is a dev-group dep the tests import.

pytest-dev/pytest-subtests is an MIT-licensed pytest plugin for running subtests. Pinned to tag v0.11.0 (2023-05-15, commit 06315b41) because HEAD already supports pytest 8: the 0.12.1 release (2024-03-07) is where 'fixed compatibility with upcoming pytest 8.1.x' landed, and a HEAD checkout of this repo was measured GREEN on pytest 8.4.1 (artifacts/phase2/pytest-subtests-pytest7-to-8/run-20261025T152858-297d83_green.json). The pre-support release is the version whose own suite still passes on pytest 7 and breaks on pytest 8.
